teachings.async: async, promises, and timer callbacks are unavailable in an app core: the host executes effects — declare a command (Cmd.fetch, Cmd.delay) or a subscription (Sub.timer) and results arrive as Msgs.

remediations.SC4013: rebuild the app: an exception escaping a core entry is contract skew between the compiled core and its host bindings, and one build regenerates both from one contract.
remediations.SC4017: restart the app process: a trapped core is poisoned and never resumes in place, and the recorded session replays deterministically.
